findings.obligation: P2/E6: no added alternative matches a production type outside Modules.Refinement
findings.observation: Non-blocking. Only alternatives that spell Modules\.Refinement are asked about outside names. Mutation: widening ModuleBoundariesArchUnitTest.RefinementPattern with |^Lighthouse\.Backend\.Modules\.[^.]+(\.|$) took it out of the role breaks and the alternative check stayed green, so an over-wide Context widening that does not name Refinement is not caught. Falsifier list in the design names only the unanchored Modules.Refinement case.
findings.remediation: Optional: also ask every Context pattern that newly matches a new Refinement namespace whether it matches a production name outside Modules.Refinement that the old alternatives did not match, or state in the design that over-wide non-Refinement alternatives are left to review.

findings.obligation: P2: every rule pattern in the test assembly keeps its role (law scans const and static readonly string fields only)
findings.observation: Non-blocking. Expression-bodied static string properties (TheServices, ThePlatformLane, TheApi, AnyContextsAdapters in PlatformLaneBoundariesArchUnitTest) are not fields, so the law does not see them. TheServices matches Services.Implementation.Refinement today and not Modules.Refinement after the move; its meaning (Platform reaches code still in Services only through listed edges) is arguably a Place that must not follow, but it is neither declared nor scanned.
findings.remediation: Record the scope in the design as fields only with TheServices judged a Place, or include properties with a constant body in the scan and declare TheServices folder-only.

observations.text: argv: dotnet build Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests.csproj; exit 0 (0 errors). Then dotnet test ... --no-build --filter "FullyQualifiedName~RefinementRulesSeeTheMoveArchUnitTest|FullyQualifiedName~PlatformLaneRulesSeeTheMoveArchUnitTest"; exit 1; Failed 2, Passed 13, Total 15, 5 s. Failed: EveryRulePatternThatSeesAMovingRefinementType_IsDeclared (names RefinementPattern, RefinementReportsAccessAndLicensing, per-type FullName patterns, RefinementAndReports, ServicesImplementationPattern, RefinementImplementationNamespace as not declared; StopsSeeingTheType old matches new does not) and TheStringsInTheTestProjectThatNameRefinementByItsOldPath_AreExactlyTheFixedRenameList (names RefinementModuleArchUnitTest.cs:31 unlisted literal). Other 5 Refinement tests and all platform tests pass. Semantic RED matches the agreed falsifier, not a setup error.

Mutation 1 (reverted by git checkout): RefinementPattern widened by anchored ^Lighthouse\.Backend\.Modules\.Refinement(\.|$). Rebuilt and ran RefinementRulesSeeTheMove filter: exit 1, 2 failed 5 passed; RefinementPattern and its composites (FlowMetrics, Forecasting, WorkItems callers) left the break list, the other patterns stayed. Law discriminates per pattern. Mutation 2: unanchored |Modules\.Refinement alternative: NoModulesRefinementAlternative test passed on the real tree because no production lookalike exists; the lookalike case is caught only by the made-up fixture test (accepted, design-conformant). Mutation 3: RefinementPattern widened by |^Lighthouse\.Backend\.Modules\.[^.]+(\.|$): RefinementPattern left the break list and the alternative check stayed green (see finding). All source reverted; git status clean.

Design binding: whole-parent list holds only PlatformLaneMembershipArchUnitTest.ModuleNamespaces (value ^Lighthouse\.Backend\.Modules(\.|$)), admits only SeesAnAreaItNeverSaw for a listed pattern that matches Modules itself and every new namespace, made-up cases cover listed, narrower and unlisted (TheWholeParentList_*). Role law via NamespaceMoveLaw (Namespace and FullName subjects, static readonly and nested fields, composites, folder-only). Rename list compared both ways (made-up Unlisted x3 and Missing x1 with lookalike, test-class namespace and governed-constant negatives). Per-test times 1 to 3 s, under budget; no timing derogation needed. Jev: unauthorized, typesafe: unavailable; nw-code-analysis-port not needed (no structural query beyond grep). Test selection: both oracle and support tests named by the bundle filter, selection non-empty (15 tests).

diagnostic: Oracle approved for craft. Semantic RED observed (2 of 7 Refinement tests fail naming the rule constants and the RefinementImplementationNamespace literal; platform tests green). Made-up cases discriminate; whole-parent list, role law, both-way rename list bound. Two non-blocking design findings (over-wide non-Refinement widening; expression-bodied pattern properties).
